## Company
Nepa is a marketing research company that helps brands turn complex data into actionable insights and real-time strategy. Its platform combines brand monitoring, media mix modelling, and campaign evaluation, researching more than 50 markets globally, tracking more than 7,500 brands and campaigns daily, and working with more than 300 blue-chip clients annually. The company describes its mission as delivering 'insight that grows your business, fast and every day,' and describes its culture as a team of creative problem-solvers focused on crafting winning solutions for its partners. Nepa is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market, with Redeye AB serving as its Certified Adviser. Its leadership team, as presented on its About page, includes CEO Anders Dahl (who announced on 2026-09-30 that he will leave Nepa during Q1 2027), Head of HR Annika Lamborn, CRO Sara Davidsson Nyman, and CPO Robert Beatus.

- Legal name: Nepa AB (publ)
- Headquarters: Magnus Ladulåsgatan 65, 118 27 Stockholm, Sweden
- Phone: +46 8 400 268 00 | Email: info@nepa.com | Website: https://nepa.com
- Leadership change: On 2026-09-30 Nepa announced that CEO Anders Dahl has resigned. He remains CEO during a transition period and will leave Nepa during the first quarter of 2027. The Board, chaired by Dan Foreman, has initiated a search for a successor.
- Social: [linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nepa_2/), [youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@NepaInsights)

## Leadership and board
### Anders Dahl - CEO
Note: Announced 2026-09-30 that he is resigning as CEO; remains in the role during a transition period and leaves Nepa during Q1 2027. Successor search initiated by the Board.
Anders Dahl is CEO of Nepa, a role he has held since March 2024, after serving as a Group Management member and interim COO since 2023. He studied Economics and Business Law at Lund University. During the 14 years prior to Nepa he held key executive and advisory roles in various B2B and B2C companies in the United States, preceded by over ten years in permanent and interim executive positions in the Nordic media market.
Source: https://nepa.com/person/anders-dahl/

### Annika Lamborn - Head of HR
Annika Lamborn is Head of HR at Nepa, where she has worked since 2009, and a Group Management member since 2024. She studied strategic communication at Berghs School of Communication and previously worked as a recruitment consultant at Academic Search.
Source: https://nepa.com/person/annika-lamborn/

Ashkan Senobari is a Nepa board member, elected in 2024. Born in 1988, he holds a BSc in Business Administration and an MSc in Finance, Hedge Funds & Private Equity from the International University of Monaco. He is a Director at Hanover Investors, leading public market deal origination and execution across Scandinavia, and also serves on the boards of ZetaDisplay AB and Lumi Gruppen AS, and as a private investor in scale-ups. He previously worked at EQT Partners (Stockholm and New York) and began his career in the M&A division of J.P. Morgan in London.

## Products
### Brand Tracking
A continuously updated brand health dashboard that measures brand awareness, perception, and purchase intent, and benchmarks the brand against competitors in real time. It uses AI-powered trend detection to flag risks and links campaign activity to shifts in brand KPIs, covering brand funnel tracking, 8 brands and 8 target groups. Plans start from 1,500 EUR (16,300 SEK) per month on the pricing page; the product page itself says from 15,000 SEK per month.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/brand-tracking/

### Marketing Mix Modelling
Continuously updated marketing mix modelling that quantifies the short-term sales impact and long-term brand-building effect of each marketing channel and campaign. Includes a budget planning tool for reallocating spend, with models refreshed weekly or monthly and built from at least 2-3 years of historical media, sales, and promotion data.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/marketing-mix-modeling/

### Campaign Pulse
A rapid campaign evaluation solution that measures whether campaigns are noticed, understood, linked to the brand, and how they affect purchase intent, benchmarked against a database of more than 2,800 campaigns. Results are typically delivered within a few days of fieldwork, and the product can be extended with Emotion Palette, Neurons, and Brand Touch add-ons.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/campaign-pulse/

### Brand Touch
Maps a brand's personality across 120 emotional attributes and 8 personality segments to show how it is perceived emotionally relative to competitors. AI-supported analysis links these personality traits to consideration, preference, and loyalty, with insights typically delivered within a few weeks.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/brand-touch/

### Brand Assets
Identifies and measures a brand's distinctive assets, such as logos, colors, slogans, and mascots, quantifying each asset's fame, uniqueness, and spill-over to competitors. Benchmarks these assets against competitors to show which drive recall and which need refinement, with results delivered within weeks.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/brand-asset/

### Brand Premium
Quantifies brand equity as a measurable KPI showing how much consumers believe a brand is worth compared with its category and key competitors. The metric can be tracked continuously inside the Brand Tracking dashboard to inform pricing decisions.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/brand-premium/

### Market Segmentation
Builds bespoke consumer segmentation models based on demographics, behaviour, needs, and values to identify which audience groups matter most for a brand's growth strategy. Every segmentation model is custom-built for the client's specific brand and market situation rather than a standardized framework.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/segmentation/

### Category Insight
An ad hoc market analysis that maps category structure, consumer behaviour and needs, and competitive benchmarking, including a brand positioning review of a brand's strengths, weaknesses, and unique associations. It does not include segmentation but is delivered with prioritized recommendations within weeks.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/category-insight/

### Paths to Purchase
Maps the full, non-linear consumer journey across digital, physical, paid, earned, and owned touchpoints, combining stated survey data with behavioural tracking data. Quantifies the conversion impact of each touchpoint and identifies the strongest purchase drivers and barriers in the category.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/path-to-purchase/

### Creative AI Analytics
Uses AI to extract hundreds of visual, audio, and contextual features from digital ad creatives across TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, and YouTube, and links those features to cost per acquisition (CPA) rather than engagement metrics. Delivers a creative playbook and re-scores new creative each quarter; a one-off baseline project typically takes four to six weeks and requires at least 50 creatives to analyze (250+ is ideal).
Page: https://nepa.com/products/creative-ai/

### Category Entry Points
Identifies the internal and external cues consumers use to recall a brand during a buying decision, helping build the 'mental availability' that drives market penetration. Uses a three-step approach of quantifying and prioritizing existing entry points, discovering new ones through qualitative and generative-AI techniques, and continuously monitoring them via the Brand Tracking dashboard.
Page: https://nepa.com/products/category-entry-points/

### Nepa Trinity
A unified decision framework combining Marketing Mix Modelling, Brand Tracking, and Campaign Pulse into one AI-supported planning tool, aimed at brands investing 20M+ per year in media. Nepa states Trinity engagements typically deliver 10-20% higher marketing ROI within 12-24 months, double-digit improvements in consideration/preference, and reduced promotion dependency.
Page: https://nepa.com/make-every-marketing-euro-work-10-20-harder/

## Solutions
### Marketing Strategy
Helps brands turn strategy into insight by clarifying what to say, who to say it to, and when to say it, using audience motivation and timing data. Works alongside Nepa's Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling, Campaign Pulse, Brand Touch, Category Entry Points, and Segmentation products.
Page: https://nepa.com/solutions/marketing-strategy/

### Brand Development
Helps build a distinctive, consistent brand by tracking brand performance over time, uncovering emotional connection, and identifying what truly differentiates a brand for its most valuable audiences. Draws on Nepa's Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling, Campaign Pulse, Brand Touch, Category Entry Points, and Segmentation products.
Page: https://nepa.com/solutions/brand-development/

### Visual Performance
Focuses on measuring how creative and visual assets perform in real time, connecting visual identity to recall, emotion, and brand perception across every channel a brand appears in. Combines Nepa's Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling, Campaign Pulse, Brand Touch, Category Entry Points, and Segmentation products to optimize creative before and during campaigns.
Page: https://nepa.com/solutions/visual-performance/

### Media Strategy
Addresses wasted media spend and media activity disconnected from brand growth by identifying which channels and touchpoints drive results, so investment can be focused where it pays back. Uses real-time insight so media plans can be adjusted while campaigns are still running.
Page: https://nepa.com/solutions/media-strategy/

### Campaign Measurement
Tracks how campaigns build awareness, consideration, and preference in real time rather than waiting for post-campaign reviews, so budgets and messaging can be adjusted mid-flight. Combines Nepa's Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling, Campaign Pulse, Brand Touch, Category Entry Points, and Segmentation products.
Page: https://nepa.com/solutions/campaign-measurement/

### Nepa BrandGrow Program
A structured, expert-led add-on for brands already running continuous Brand Tracking with Nepa. Combines tracking data with external context (market share, media investment, trend reports, Google Search data) via a facilitated working session to turn tracking results into a shared view of priorities and an agreed action plan. Nepa states clients typically see 10-30% improvements in marketing efficiency from better-directed brand strategy.
Page: https://nepa.com/nepa-brandgrow-program/

## Case studies
### A fashion retailer's journey: From challenge to triumph
Industry: Fashion retailer | Service: Brand Tracking, Campaign Evaluation, Marketing Mix Modelling
A leading European fashion retailer saw flat revenue despite a 50% increase in media spend. Nepa's Trinity Suite (Brand Tracking, Campaign Evaluation, Marketing Mix Modelling) identified declining long-term brand health, low sender recall, and an imbalanced media mix as the root causes. Addressing these issues improved brand health, optimized media spending, and drove sustained sales growth.
- Increase in baseline sales: 20%
- Actual annual sales increase: 16%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/a-fashion-retailers-journey-from-challenge-to-triumph/

### Business Finland – Repositioning Finland through food
Client: Business Finland (Visit Finland) | Industry: Tourism and food exports | Service: Market research, category insights
Business Finland partnered with Nepa to understand how Finland and Finnish food are perceived globally in order to sharpen the country's international destination strategy. Nepa combined a digital and content audit of Nordic tourism channels with a multi-market traveller study to reveal that Finland shared the same 'fresh, natural, pure' narrative as its Nordic neighbours but lacked a distinctive voice and underused food as an engagement driver. The work gave Business Finland a clearer brand narrative built around real, relatable food experiences.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/business-finland/

### Cure Media and Akademibokhandeln
Client: Cure Media and Akademibokhandeln | Industry: Retail and social media marketing | Service: Creator & influencer campaign evaluation
Cure Media, a European creator marketing agency, worked with Nepa to help Swedish book retailer Akademibokhandeln move beyond vanity metrics and measure the real business impact of creator marketing. Two Instagram/TikTok campaigns (autumn 2024 and spring 2025) were evaluated by comparing followers to non-followers, isolating the effect of creator exposure on awareness, message clarity, liking, brand fit and purchase intent.
- Followers who saw at least one campaign post: 63%
- Followers who liked the content: 79%
- Said they were likely to buy from Akademibokhandeln after seeing the campaign: 27%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/cure-media-and-akademibokhandeln/

### Fortnox turning insight into direction
Client: Fortnox | Industry: Fintech | Service: Category Insight, Brand Tracking
As Fortnox expanded from an accounting service into a broader business platform, it partnered with Nepa to clarify brand positioning, understand evolving customer perceptions, and align product and messaging strategy with genuine customer needs. Nepa's Category Insight mapped the competitive landscape, and continuous Brand Tracking let Fortnox measure the impact of each strategic shift over time.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/fortnox-turning-insight-into-direction/

### From ad hoc insights to top of mind strategy (Fastighetsbyrån)
Client: Fastighetsbyrån | Industry: Real Estate | Service: Brand Tracking, Campaign Evaluation, Brand Touch, Insight Community
Fastighetsbyrån, Sweden's largest real estate agency with over 270 offices, relied on one-off studies that made it hard to track brand performance over time. By moving to continuous Brand Tracking with Nepa, plus Brand Touch and Insight Community for deeper strategic work, the company gained a clearer, faster view of brand and campaign performance to support decision-making.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/from-fragmented-insights-to-strategy-fastighetsbyran/

### GANT trusts Nepa to help it grow
Client: GANT | Industry: Fashion & Lifestyle | Service: Brand Tracking, Market Analysis, Consumer Insights
GANT partnered with Nepa to conduct an in-depth market analysis across its 70 operating markets, identifying its competitive position and defining core KPIs. Nepa developed continuous brand health trackers now covering eleven of GANT's main target markets, giving the team 24/7 access to insights via a KPI dashboard alongside regular meetings to interpret data and track year-on-year trends.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/gant-trusts-nepa-to-help-it-grow/

### From lookalike to standout: Hemköp’s bold path to brand clarity with Nepa
Client: Hemköp | Industry: Grocery retail | Service: Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Brand Asset Study, Campaign Evaluation
Despite over 90% brand recognition, Hemköp's advertising was often confused with competitors, meaning its media budget was inadvertently building rival brands. A Nepa Brand Asset Study revealed that Hemköp's color palette overlapped with competitors ICA and Willys, prompting a redesigned, more distinctive visual identity. A subsequent Marketing Mix Modeling analysis with Nepa confirmed that these successive, data-driven changes had a greater impact than one-off fixes.
- Brand attribution: +36%
- Ad liking: +29%
- Preference: +19%
- Purchase intent: +8%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/hemkop/

### How Atria identified the brand cues that matter most
Client: Atria | Industry: Food & FMCG | Service: Distinctive Brand Asset Audit
Atria wanted to move beyond simple awareness metrics to understand which of its logos, colours, pack designs, origin cues, slogan and sonic branding genuinely drive growth. Nepa's Distinctive Brand Assets study, rooted in Ehrenberg-Bass Institute principles, measured the uniqueness and fame of each asset, giving Atria a tiered playbook ('must use', 'supporting', 'use with care') to guide campaigns, packaging and retail visibility.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/how-atria-identified-the-brand-cues-that-matter-most/

### How Creative AI analytics helped Wolt unlock a potential 40%+ CPA reduction on TikTok
Client: Wolt | Industry: Food delivery / Q-commerce | Service: Creative AI Analytics, Campaign Evaluation
Wolt runs thousands of always-on TikTok campaigns with no unified, evidence-based view of what makes an ad perform. Working with Nepa and TikTok, Wolt used Creative AI analytics to classify features across thousands of ad assets, ran a statistical drivers analysis linking features to CPA, and built a composite Creative Score that fed a custom TikTok Creative Playbook. Key findings: low brand-logo frequency outperformed heavy branding, high visible-face frequency was the strongest performance driver, and low food-in-frame frequency outperformed generic food shots.
- Potential CPA reduction moving from current to best-practice creative: 40%
- CPA difference between top 10% and bottom 10% of creatives: 60%+
- Ads below 'good' creative level at time of analysis: 86%
- Wolt ads with very high logo frequency (despite low frequency performing best): 29%
- Wolt ads with low or no face visibility (despite faces being the strongest performance driver): 41%
- Potential CPA reduction for both brand and acquisition campaign types following best-practice guidelines: 37-38%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/how-creative-ai-analytics-helped-wolt-unlock-a-potential-40-cpa-reduction-on-tiktok/

### How Dafgårds used insight to regain consumer trust
Client: Dafgårds | Industry: Food & Beverage | Service: Category Insight, Brand Tracking, Brand Asset Study, Campaign Measurement
After the 2013 horse meat scandal, family-owned Swedish food company Dafgårds responded with years of low-profile communication. Starting in 2019, Nepa ran a Category Insight study to give Dafgårds a unified strategic direction, followed by ongoing Brand Tracking, a 2024 Brand Asset Study, and campaign measurement supporting a test-and-learn approach. Backed by these insights, Dafgårds relaunched its Billys and Gorbys sub-brands and moved from recovery to category leadership.
- Increase in marketing investment (backed by confidence in insights): 600%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/how-dafgards-used-insight-to-regain-consumer-trust/

### If Insurance – the leading property and casualty insurance company in the Nordics
Client: If Insurance | Industry: Insurance | Service: Cross-Market Measurement Framework
If Insurance sought a holistic measurement framework beyond individual creative testing to understand the long-term impact of brand advertising across Sweden, Finland, Denmark and Norway. Nepa co-developed a structured measurement framework built around five principles (balancing long- and short-term activity, reaching the right audience, consistency of investment and creative, clear links to the brand, and emotional resonance), enabling consistent, actionable measurement across all four markets.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/if-insurance/

### Kellogg's trusts Nepa to help it remain relevant
Client: Kellogg's | Industry: Food Manufacturing | Service: Brand Tracking, Market Analysis, Consumer Insights
To support a Pringles re-launch with fresh creative and new flavors, Kellogg's had Nepa conduct an omni-channel paths-to-purchase analysis across 10 global markets (including India, the UK, Korea, France and Brazil), covering channels from eCommerce to convenience stores. The findings shaped Kellogg's global shopper strategy and became the basis for a new shopper toolkit adopted as the global Kellogg's standard.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/kelloggs-trusts-nepa-to-help-it-remain-relevant/

### MTV trusts Nepa to prove TV advertising is key
Client: MTV | Industry: TV broadcasting | Service: Campaign Evaluation, Brand Tracking, Consumer Panel
MTV, Finland's leading commercial broadcaster, partnered with Nepa to use Campaign Evaluations to quantify the impact of TV advertising for its clients. Nepa also aggregated years of historic Campaign Evaluation data across many advertisers into a Meta Analysis, quantifiably proving the long-term brand-building benefits of TV and program sponsorship advertising.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/mtv-trusts-nepa-to-prove-tv-advertising-is-key/

### Navigating complexity in a transforming beverage category (Sinebrychoff)
Client: Sinebrychoff | Industry: Beverages | Service: Shopper Journey Mapping, Trend Tracking, Retailer Deep Dives, Category and Activation Strategy Support
Sinebrychoff, Finland's leading brewery and part of the Carlsberg Group, partnered with Nepa in 2022 to map shopper journeys across beverage categories in Finnish grocery retail, then re-ran an expanded quantitative study in 2025 (approximately 1,000 recent buyers per category across beer, cider, long drinks and RTD) to track how shopper behaviour had evolved. Results were split by retailer to enable targeted deep dives for key retail clients.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/navigating-complexity-in-a-transforming-beverage-category/

### From insight to impact: SBAB unlocked a new engine of insight
Client: SBAB | Industry: Mortgage market, financial services | Service: Continuous Marketing Mix Modelling (cMMM), Brand Touch, Brand Tracker, Qualitative Diary Study, Campaign Pulse
SBAB needed to balance short-term sales with long-term brand strength in a saturated Swedish mortgage market. Nepa combined Continuous Marketing Mix Modelling, Brand Touch, Brand Tracker, a Qualitative Diary Study of the housing journey, and Campaign Pulse to sharpen SBAB's positioning and link perceptions to real-world behaviour. Continuous MMM in particular let SBAB clearly show which marketing investments delivered measurable business outcomes, shifting internal conversations with the CFO and CEO.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/sbab/

### Telenor trusts Nepa to understand their business needs
Client: Telenor | Industry: Telecommunications | Service: Brand Tracking, Consumer Insights, B2B and B2C Market Analysis
Telenor partnered with Nepa to set up brand trackers in Sweden, Denmark and Finland, monitoring preference, NPS and awareness over time. Regular cross-market meetings and Nepa's advanced package analysis helped Telenor turn raw tracking data into actionable recommendations for pricing, packaging and marketing strategy.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/telenor-trusts-nepa-to-understand-their-business-needs/

### Fjällräven’s global success through Insights
Client: Fjällräven | Industry: Apparel & Gear | Service: Brand Funnel Analysis, Competitive Performance Tracking, Brand Position Development, Media Investment Analysis
As Fjällräven expanded beyond the Nordics, it partnered with Nepa in 2023 to implement a consistent brand tracking system across markets. Nepa's brand funnel analysis, competitive performance tracking and brand position development, combined with AI-driven trend insights and media investment data folded into the brand tracker, gave Fjällräven real-time feedback on marketing decisions and short-term effects across global markets.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/turning-insights-into-impact-fjallravens-approach-to-global-brand-growth/

### VARNER trusts Nepa to uncover its potential
Client: VARNER | Industry: Fashion & Retail | Service: Brand Tracking, Market Analysis, Consumer Insights
Norwegian retail group VARNER (Cubus, Dressmann, Bik Bok, Carlings, Volt, Junkyard and Levi's stores) implemented a continuous Nepa brand tracker to understand how each of its retail chains performed and where growth opportunities existed. Quarterly reports, insight meetings and a real-time dashboard gave VARNER chain-level and group-level visibility to strengthen both individual brands and the wider group.
Source: https://nepa.com/case/varner-trusts-nepa-to-uncover-its-potential/

### How Eckes-Granini launched Marli Juissi® Energy with Nepa
Client: Eckes-Granini | Industry: Beverages / FMCG – Juice and Energy Drinks | Service: Idea tournament and concept screening, Concept testing with trial-rate calibration, Category insight, Packaging/flavour/naming optimisation
Eckes-Granini needed to validate which of several juice-based energy and wellness concepts would resonate with Finnish consumers in a crowded, globally-dominated energy drink category. Starting with a 2021 concept screening and continuing through a 2025 follow-up study, Nepa combined concept evaluation, trial-rate calibration and benchmarking against 88 Nordic beverage reference concepts to guide positioning, packaging, flavour and naming decisions for Marli Juissi® Energy, which is now available in stores.
Source: https://nepa.com/launching-marli-juissi-energy/

### How Lantmännen and Nepa measure the value advertising builds over time
Client: Lantmännen | Industry: Agriculture | Service: Brand Tracking, Advertising Equity
Lantmännen, the Swedish agricultural cooperative behind brands such as AXA, Kungsörnen, GoGreen and Finn Crisp, added Nepa's advertising equity measure to its continuous brand tracking to see whether years of consistent communication had built a lasting asset. Advertising equity was read alongside brand metrics and media effectiveness, treating each campaign as part of an accumulated asset rather than a separate event.
- Growth in advertising equity after the renewed communication platform launched in 2021: +25%
- Positive attitude towards the brand (2011 starting point → today): 54% → 86%
- Advertising equity index in Nepa’s Advertising Equity 2026 benchmark (top 30 of 95 Swedish brands): 107
- Campaign observations: Increased over time with constant annual media investment
Source: https://nepa.com/case/measure-the-value-advertising-builds-over-time/

### Using data to sharpen a specialist brand in a crowded market
Client: Laattapiste-Pukkila | Industry: Retail (specialist retailer for bathroom and flooring materials) | Service: Brand study, Campaign evaluation
Laattapiste-Pukkila, a family-owned Finnish specialist in tiles and bathroom solutions, was well known but did not convert awareness strongly enough into consideration and preference against large DIY chains. Nepa ran a tailored campaign evaluation and two consecutive years of brand dip studies across Finland's key urban areas, mapping the funnel from awareness to store visits and the brand's positioning against competitors. The findings were distilled into one clear brand promise.
- Booked customer appointments after the renewed brand promise: +30%
Source: https://nepa.com/case/laattapiste-pukkila/

Case-study results are past outcomes for a specific client, not guarantees.

## FAQ (from the Brand Tracking product page)

### What makes Nepa's Brand Tracking different from traditional solutions?
Unlike traditional trackers that deliver data weeks later, Nepa provides real-time brand health insights powered by AI-enhanced analysis. This means you can act faster, spot risks earlier, and make smarter marketing decisions—without waiting for static reports.

### How does AI improve my brand tracking?
Our AI models continuously scan your brand data to detect trends, highlight risks and opportunities, and link campaigns to brand outcomes. You'll see changes as they happen—not weeks later—so you can adapt strategy in real time.

### What kind of brand metrics can I track with Nepa?
You can track brand awareness, perception, loyalty, and campaign impact. Add-ons like Category Entry Points, BrandPremium, and Brand Touch let you go even deeper—quantifying brand equity, mental availability, and emotional positioning.

### Can I customize what I see in the dashboards?
Yes. From onboarding, we tailor your dashboards around your KPIs, filters, and audiences. You'll get clear, easy-to-use views that deliver clarity, not clutter, and support faster decision-making.

### What kind of support will I get after going live?
You'll have a dedicated team of experts monitoring your data, flagging important shifts, and guiding actions—no ticket system needed. We also hold regular insight meetings to turn data into strategy and help you prove ROI.

### Who is Nepa's Brand Tracking best suited for?
It's ideal for marketing leaders who need to prove brand impact quickly, optimize spend, and connect efforts directly to growth. Especially valuable for brands seeking to move faster and stay ahead of shifting markets.

### How do I get started?
Just book a demo. In less than an hour, we'll show you how smarter tracking can elevate your strategy and accelerate brand growth—starting today.

### How often is brand tracking data updated?
Brand data is collected continuously and refreshed weekly, giving you near real-time visibility into awareness, perception, and campaign effectiveness.

### Can I track multiple brands or markets at the same time?
Yes. You can monitor multiple brands, competitors, or regions within one dashboard and compare results across audiences and campaigns.

### How much does Nepa's Brand Tracking platform cost?
Pricing starts at 15,000 SEK/month, including brand funnel tracking, 8 brands, 8 target groups, and unlimited logins. Custom plans are available for larger needs. Note (crawls 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-16): this is the answer as published on the product page. The pricing page widget lists Brand Tracking Mini from 1,500 EUR (16,300 SEK)/month — see #pricing .

### Can Nepa's Brand Tracking connect with my marketing or CRM data?
Yes. Nepa's platform integrates with marketing analytics and CRM systems, allowing you to link brand performance directly to campaign and sales results.

### How long does it take to set up brand tracking?
Most clients go live within a few weeks. Our team handles onboarding, data setup, and dashboard configuration so you can start tracking insights quickly.

### What industries does Nepa's Brand Tracking work best for?
Nepa works across industries including FMCG, retail, finance, and tech. The platform adapts to your specific KPIs and competitive landscape.

### Can I benchmark my brand against competitors?
Absolutely. Nepa's dashboards allow you to compare your brand performance against competitors across awareness, perception, and loyalty metrics.
